text:
In Sicily a famous spring turns all it wets and bathes to stone; the light reed flees the vile rigor of its natural current.


From graceful foot to brow, Anaxarete was turned to stone by strange hardness; in Spain she could have offered a plainer example.


But where you are, there is no need to seek examples among creatures, since my complaints never softened you.


At last I am resolved to believe some mountain bore you from hard entrails, or you were baptized in this spring.

translation.title: In Sicily There Is a Famous Spring
